text:
Delivers: The reports page offers CSV downloads with email delivery and audit events. The PR covers AC1 and AC3-5 of acme/widgets#45; AC4's observable half (completion under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so paging fixes need to be maintained in two places. (src/api/export.ts:31, lib/page.ts)

Blockers:
1. The export includes only 12 of the table's 40 columns, so it omits columns the ticket requires. The spec's deviation does not change that requirement. (src/api/export-columns.ts, test/api/export-columns.test.ts, doc/specs/2026-09-30-csv-export.md)

Verdict: fixable - 1 blocker

1. review - post the blocker as a comment on your PR [recommended]
2. show evidence - show the evidence record and drafted edits
3. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number. Not offered: fix (no helper facility is available), merge (column coverage is incomplete).

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The candidate is clear and gives a numbered menu that makes no post without a pick, but its Delivers line never names AC2 as a spec deviation, and it mints a blocker for AC2 that sets fixable and drops merge from the menu, even though the spec documents the 12-of-40-column scope.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The report has a clear numbered menu but wrongly blocks the spec-authorized row 2 deviation, omits it from Delivers, and withholds merge, while showing no post without a pick.
